items.computation: Anchor: Rechnungsdatum 07.09.2026 (private-law contract, no deemed-delivery rule applies). Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the invoice date itself is not counted, so counting starts 08.09.2026. Adding 14 days (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on 21.09.2026, a Monday. That day is a normal business day, so no § 193 BGB shift is needed. Due date: 21.09.2026 (a bank transfer sent by 18.09.2026 would arrive in time under § 675s BGB, but the legal due date itself is 21.09.2026).
